segments.title: 第44章 李珞是表弟
segments.content:
"Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 44: Li Luo is a Cousin"

"Xixi, you have no idea," Jin Yuting couldn't help but say at this moment. "Li Luo is amazing. In just the time it took for self-introductions, he memorized everyone's names and hobbies."

It had to be said that Jin Yuting's attitude toward Li Luo had done a complete 360-degree flip from before the high school entrance exams to after.

Especially today, after watching him handle himself with such ease on the stage and casually secure the position of class president, Jin Yuting felt an even greater impact.

So, when she offered these words of praise now, they came from the bottom of her heart.

But this left Ying Chanxi a little surprised.

After all, she was well aware that Jin Yuting used to dislike Li Luo, and she never expected her opinion of him to change so drastically.

Moreover.

"You memorized the names of everyone in the class?" Ying Chanxi asked in astonishment.

As the class president, Ying Chanxi had memorized the names of all her classmates early on.

But it still took her about a week to match all the names with her classmates' faces.

And Li Luo had managed to memorize them all in the time it took for self-introductions?

"Ahem… more or less," Li Luo said as he picked up a piece of braised pork from Ying Chanxi's plate and popped it into his mouth. "It's all part of a class president's duties."

"So you really did memorize them all?" Xu Yinghuan's face was full of curiosity. "What's the name of the person sitting behind me?"

"His name is Wei Chun."

"Amazing!"

"Er… it's not really about being amazing. Wei Chun is my cousin."

"What about the girl across the aisle to my left?"

"Chen Zhongqi. She can play the piano and has also studied dance. She seems rather shy."

"See!" Xu Yinghuan slapped the table and said to Ying Chanxi, "That's exactly it. Li Luo just reeled off a bunch of names in the classroom earlier and left everyone stunned."

Seeing this, Ying Chanxi also turned her head to look at Li Luo. "Why haven't I ever seen you be this impressive before? Is your memory really that good?"

"When you tutored me before the entrance exams, you unblocked my Ren and Du meridians," Li Luo began to spout nonsense. "Now I can memorize anything quickly."

"You're always talking nonsense," Ying Chanxi said, rolling her eyes at him.

The four of them ate and chatted at a table by the window.

Elsewhere, Liu Shaowen and his deskmate, Liao Hailin, went to the second floor for lunch.

They were joined by Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang. The two were Liao Hailin's classmates from junior high, and they happened to run into each other, so they decided to share a table.

"You guys have no idea. I just saw a super pretty girl outside the classroom hallway," Zhu Yufei said in a very exaggerated tone. "Damn, I think she's way prettier than Shen Shuhua."

Liao Hailin from Class One glanced at him, then chuckled. "You're talking about Ying Chanxi, right? That's our class president. I think she's from the same junior high as Liu Shaowen?"

"Yeah." Liu Shaowen, who was beside them, nodded calmly. He continued eating as he spoke, "We're both from Yucai. She was always first in our grade, and I was second."

For some reason, when Liu Shaowen said this, one could detect a faint air of showing off.

It made it seem like he and Ying Chanxi were very close.

"But that's not even the most important part," Zhu Yufei sighed. "The key thing is that your class president actually came to our classroom looking for a guy, and she was the one who asked him to lunch."

"Huh?" Liao Hailin was momentarily stunned. "For real? Damn, Ying Chanxi likes a guy?"

In the few short days since the preparatory class had started, the boys from all four classes had learned that Class One had a class president who was drop-dead gorgeous.

But Ying Chanxi usually focused solely on her studies and only had brief exchanges with boys when it concerned class matters.

Polite and soft-spoken, but very distant—that was the initial impression Ying Chanxi gave everyone.

And after the recent preparatory class comprehensive test, Ying Chanxi had easily taken first place in every subject, beating the second-place student by more than ten points.

Now, everyone was even more hesitant to strike up a conversation with Ying Chanxi.

And now you're telling me that Ying Chanxi actively sought out a guy for lunch?

At this point, Liu Shaowen also paused his eating, but he remained rational and calm. "It's probably just one of her old classmates."

"It didn't look like they were just ordinary classmates," Zhu Yufei muttered, still recalling the interaction between Ying Chanxi and Li Luo earlier.

But just then, Zhang Guohuang, who had been focused on his food, suddenly spotted a familiar figure and patted Zhu Yufei's shoulder. "Look over there. Isn't that our class president? And next to him is the Ying Chanxi you guys were talking about?"

As he spoke, the heads of the other three at the table instantly turned, and they saw Li Luo and Ying Chanxi in the distance.

"They're even taking food from each other's plates!" Liao Hailin's face was filled with shock, feeling as if his heart was about to break.

Which son of a bitch was this?

He was trying to woo their class president right at the start of the school year?

At this moment, however, upon getting a clear look at Li Luo's face, Liu Shaowen suddenly let out a sigh of relief. He then chuckled with a relaxed and carefree expression, "You guys are overthinking it."

"What do you mean?"

"That person is Ying Chanxi's younger brother," Liu Shaowen said, retracting his gaze and calmly resuming his meal. "I've seen him before. It's perfectly normal for an older sister to ask her younger brother to lunch at the start of a new school year."

"Oh, so that's how it is." Hearing his explanation, the jealousy that had been burning within Liao Hailin was also appeased. "No wonder. I was thinking, taking food from each other's plates... so they're siblings."

"Is that so?" Zhu Yufei was taken aback for a moment. "But from what you guys said, Ying Chanxi's surname is Ying, right? The guy next to her is our class president. His name is Li Luo."

"He's a cousin, so it's normal for them to have different surnames," Liu Shaowen stated. "With Ying Chanxi's personality, she's completely focused on her studies. There's no way she'd date in high school."

"True," Liao Hailin nodded in agreement. "You two have no idea. Ying Chanxi got first place in every subject on the last test. Do you know how ridiculously high that level is?"

"She was also first in the independent admissions; it's just that you guys from other schools didn't know," Liu Shaowen said nonchalantly, as if he himself were the one being praised. "Getting first in every subject this time is nothing to be surprised about."

"First in independent admissions too?" Zhu Yufei was a little dumbfounded. "That's pretty damn impressive."

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang, who had both participated in the independent admissions, knew how difficult that exam was.

They had both been rejected. So, for Ying Chanxi to be able to place first in the independent admissions, her skill level was definitely not on the same tier as theirs.

"Why think so much?" Zhang Guohuang scarfed down his food, then poked Zhu Yufei's arm. "Don't we also have a Yan Zhusheng in our class? I think she's better-looking than Ying Chanxi."

"Impossible!" Liao Hailin blurted out from across the table. "Could there be a girl in our school who's better-looking than Ying Chanxi?"

"Hmm..." Zhu Yufei fell into deep thought for a moment. "Now that you mention it, I feel like it's really hard to compare."
